assignments.evidence: Kin slot '[title] NAME sekafako' like dabon/galu; never in 'NAME Xfako NAME' labels (parent term); per-gender balance of kin counts puts it with the male terms
'yubi dultuzo' offered to the yu (beside wutibi 'to the house'); 'fupur ne yumu dapukzo' built the yu of Fupur; lists end 'yune wolomu'
Royal annals: 'yowidu wakizo' done to men, beside resdo (seize) and sape (take) for booty
Only in benedictions 'sezi gun/zura/suse pafora', poured like wu (milk); never counted in lists, so the libation water
'hekdobi/topibi/biyirbi seyozo' with the -bi 'to' ending on place names
Benediction verb used only with liquids: wu (milk) and sezi
Counted good found only in temple dedications (often beside lurufo), never in ration lists; paired with gold as the votive metal
Joins the last two counted items: 'folofudu 568 ma nedu 165', 'kikrira 4 ma zohu 20'
Third royal title 'monharzas RNAME robo RNAME gemoyun RNAME'; also a common official title in epitaphs; 'gemoyundu fo seyozo'
'gemoyundu fo seyozo' puts fo in the number slot after a -du plural, like 'yowidu 153'
First royal title; 'monharzas RNAME fupurne dozezo' (beloved of Fupur) leads the campaigns, building and gifts
'yowidu 153 fokladu 87 hizadu sapezo' (captives) and 'folofudu .. ma nedu .. sapezo' (herds) taken in war
Closes lists of cattle, bread, milk and beer: 'yune wolomu' = the temple's offering(s)
Kin slot and 'NAME malumufako NAME' labels alongside dabon/pizu/zitomu/galu; balance of kin counts makes it the female term
Second royal title between king and prince; also a royal dedicant and label title, never a relative's title in epitaphs
Heads every votive text: 'gurdenpir sune NAME [title] [gifts] yubi dultuzo wepakne togulra'
What the king gives after building a temple: 'yumu dapukzo lurufo 47 gukhizo'; also a votive gift, never in ration lists

Fixed filiation 'NAME sutufako NAME girisfako', after sutu 'born of (mother)'
Closing wish 'wepakne togulra' (may (the god) protect life); gukhi already covers give
Kin slot and the second most common 'NAME pizufako NAME' filiation label; groups with the male kin terms
Given ('zohu gun gukhira') beside bread in benedictions and counted beside bread and milk in lists and gifts
Not in the corpus; the kin meaning left over by elimination
Benediction adjective beside gun (abundant) and zura (pure); 'susefako' (is good) beside 'pirafako' (is great)

Herd taken as booty with cows ('folofudu 568 ma nedu 165 sapezo'); in lists and gifts
'kikrira gun gukhira' (bread) and the king's 'lurufo 47 gukhizo' to the temple
